response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing. This kingdom's aesthetic is so... medieval. So... traditional.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER JACK, approaches the king.

JESTER JACK
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I want to modernize this kingdom, Jester. I want it to be... futuristic.

JESTER JACK
But, Your Majesty, this is a medieval kingdom. We can't just... vaporwave it.

KING REGINALD
Nonsense, Jester! I've seen the most fantastical things in my travels. I've seen cities that float in the air, and robots that do the king's bidding. I can make this kingdom just as... futuristic.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his advisors, LORD THOMAS and LADY ISABELLA.

LORD THOMAS
Your Majesty, are you quite sure this is a good idea? We can't just... turn our kingdom into a... a... a...

KING REGINALD
A vaporwave utopia, Thomas! Think of it! We'll have neon lights and holographic projections and... and... and...

LADY ISABELLA
But, Your Majesty, what about the peasants? They'll be confused.

KING REGINALD
Pish posh, Isabella! The peasants will love it. They'll be... mesmerized by the... the... the...

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The buildings are now covered in neon lights and holographic projections. The knights are now wearing futuristic armor, and the peasants are sporting... vaporwave-inspired clothing.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Ah, yes. This is more like it.

Suddenly, a group of peasants approach the king.

PEASANT 1
Your Majesty, what's going on? This is all so... strange.

KING REGINALD
Ah, yes. I've decided to... modernize the kingdom. Make it... futuristic.

PEASANT 2
But, Your Majesty, we don't understand.

KING REGINALD
Don't worry, my friends. I'll explain it to you. (to himself) Eventually.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is now surrounded by his advisors, who are all wearing... vaporwave-inspired clothing.

LORD THOMAS
Your Majesty, I think we're making progress.

LADY ISABELLA
But, Your Majesty, what about the peasants? They're still confused.

KING REGINALD
Pfft, they'll get used to it. (to himself) Eventually.

Suddenly, a group of courtiers, COURTIER 1 and COURTIER 2, approach the king.

COURTIER 1
Your Majesty, we've been watching the peasants. They're... adapting.

COURTIER 2
Yes, Your Majesty. They're even... enjoying it.

KING REGINALD
Ah, excellent! (to himself) I knew it would work.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a full-fledged vaporwave utopia. The peasants are dancing in the streets, wearing... vaporwave-inspired clothing. The knights are now riding... hoverbikes.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Ah, yes. This is the life.

FADE TO BLACK.
